title: NASA-UAP-D029, Apollo 17 Crew Medical Debriefing (Continued), 1972
what_is_it: Audio recording of a NASA post-mission crew medical debriefing (part 2 of 2).
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extracted from the file (scanned/OCR-poor audio transcript); all facts here derive from war.gov metadata, not the document body.
The 'light flash phenomena' is a well-documented cosmic-ray retinal effect, not evidence of unidentified aerial phenomena, despite the file's inclusion in a UAP collection.
Claims about which crew members saw flashes and where are drawn from the catalogue description and cannot be verified against the primary audio here.
